system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, listen—I’m not happy. I bought a speaker from you guys, paid more for it, and it’s not even water-resistant. That’s ridiculous. I want to return it, obviously.

Also, in another order, I got a 17-inch laptop by mistake or whatever. I want to change that to a 13-inch one. If you don’t have the exact same model, just tell me all the 13-inch options you have. And don’t try to upsell me on i7 or weird colors—I want i5, and only silver or black. Can you handle that, or is this going to be a hassle?

Well? Are you going to help me or what? I don’t have all day here. I want to return that overpriced, useless speaker, and I want my laptop switched to a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. Don’t make this more complicated than it needs to be. What’s the next step?

Wow, seriously? Is anyone even working there? I’ve already explained what I want—return the useless, expensive speaker and swap my 17-inch laptop for a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. If you can’t do that, just say so. Otherwise, tell me exactly what I need to do right now.

Unbelievable. Is this how you treat your customers? I’ve told you three times now: I want to return the overpriced, non-water-resistant speaker, and I want to change my 17-inch laptop order to a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. If you don’t have that, list every 13-inch option you have. 

Can someone competent actually respond and get this sorted? I’m not waiting all day.

This is a joke, right? Four times now and still nothing. Are you just ignoring me? I want to return the useless, expensive speaker and swap my 17-inch laptop for a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. If you don’t have that, tell me every 13-inch option you have. 

Is there anyone there who actually knows what they’re doing? Get this sorted out now.

Wow, you people are unbelievable. How hard is it to answer a simple request? I want to return the overpriced, non-water-resistant speaker—shouldn’t be this complicated. And I want my 17-inch laptop changed to a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. If you can’t manage that, just give me the full list of 13-inch options. 

If you’re not going to help, just say so and I’ll take my business somewhere else. This is ridiculous.

Are you kidding me? Still nothing? This is the worst customer service I’ve ever seen. I want to return the useless, expensive speaker and swap my 17-inch laptop for a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. If you can’t do that, tell me every 13-inch option you have. 

How many times do I need to repeat myself? Get someone on this NOW or I’m done with your company.

Unreal. I’ve repeated myself over and over and still no response. Is this some kind of prank? I want to return the overpriced, non-water-resistant speaker, and I want my 17-inch laptop changed to a 13-inch, i5, silver or black. If you don’t have that, just tell me every 13-inch option you have. 

If you can’t handle something this basic, just say so. Otherwise, fix this now.

I’m sorry for the frustration — I can absolutely help, but first I need to authenticate your account and get the specific order details so I can take the right actions.

Please provide one of the following so I can locate your user id right now:
- Your email address (fastest), OR
- Your first name, last name, and zip code.

Also please give (if you have them) the order IDs for:
- the speaker order (the one you want to return), and
- the laptop order (the 17" order you want changed).

If you don’t have the order IDs, tell me:
- Whether the speaker order is marked “delivered” (you said it was delivered) and how you want the refund issued — back to the original payment method or to an existing gift card on file.
- For the laptop order: confirm it’s still “pending” (so it can be modified). If you don’t know, I’ll check.

Finally, confirm this policy detail so I proceed correctly:
- For the laptop swap, you want a 13" model with i5 and color either silver or black. If we don’t have the exact same model, you want me to list every 13" option that matches i5 + silver/black.

Once you provide your email (or name+zip) and the order IDs or confirmations above, I’ll look up your account and orders and tell you exactly what can be done and the next steps. I’ll also list the exact actions I’ll take and ask you to confirm (yes) before making any changes.

Finally, someone responds. About time.

Email is aarav.santos8321@example.com for the speaker, and aarav.santos8320@example.com for the laptop. I don’t have the order IDs handy—shouldn’t you be able to find them with my email? The speaker was delivered, obviously, or I wouldn’t be returning it. Refund it to my original payment method, not some useless gift card.

Now get on with it.
